name: Radar Sweep
description: Green radar scopes with range rings and crosshairs, each beam sweeping outward from the middle of the sheet and trailing its fading wake, with amber blips.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-clip-path: circle(46% at 50% 50%); clip-path: circle(46% at 50% 50%); background: radial-gradient(3.6% 3.6% at @r(22%, 78%) @r(22%, 78%), var(--color4) 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(2.6% 2.6% at @r(22%, 78%) @r(22%, 78%), var(--color4) 100%, transparent 100%), @p(var(--color1)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color2); -webkit-mask: @var(--scope); mask: @var(--scope); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: @var(--sweep); mask: @var(--sweep); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(atan2(@dx, 0 - @dy) * 57.2958 + @rn(-50, 50, 1.2))deg); transform: rotate(@calc(atan2(@dx, 0 - @dy) * 57.2958 + @rn(-50, 50, 1.2))deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --sweep: conic-gradient(transparent 0 270deg, #00000026 270deg 300deg, #00000059 300deg 324deg, #0000009e 324deg 344deg, #000 344deg 360deg); --scope: repeating-radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 0 1.8%, transparent 1.8% 23%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 49.2%, #000 49.2% 50.8%, transparent 50.8%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 49.2%, #000 49.2% 50.8%, transparent 50.8%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
